summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to provide a monthly update of its net asset value (NAV) per share and a breakdown of total NAV components as of April 30, 2026. No transaction, tender offer, merger, spin-off, or other special situation is announced. The filing discloses NAV per share calculations and asset breakdowns as a routine periodic disclosure for a non-traded REIT. This is a standard informational filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, activist activity, strategic review, or restructuring is described. The registrant is the issuer providing routine valuation information to shareholders.
